name: configuration-module-outside-the-program
description: A configuration file no compiler configuration includes is read all the same, and so is a file it imports by a relative specifier: an import of a dependency in the imported file is a use of the dependency, so that dependency is reported under no code, while a development dependency nothing imports is reported. A relative specifier resolves to the file it names, to a TypeScript file whose extension stands for the JavaScript extension the specifier writes, and to a directory's index file.
